# Community Code of Conduct

We aim to keep participation in Mail welcoming and respectful. Be considerate,
assume good intent, give constructive feedback, and focus criticism on ideas
and work rather than people.

Harassment, discrimination, personal attacks, threats, doxxing, and disruptive
behavior are not acceptable. Follow the rules of GitHub and any project space
where you participate.

Project maintainers may remove content or restrict participation when needed
to address harmful behavior. To report abuse hosted on GitHub, use
[GitHub's report abuse form](https://github.com/contact/report-abuse).
